• A relation-incidence proof of Tohăneanu's low-exponent supersolvability conjecture
    13 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

    Supersolvability in characteristic zero for finite central free arrangements of distinct hyperplanes with nonzero exponents 1 or 2 and at most one 3.

    PDF · Zenodo

• An explicit SU(5) lens-space counterexample to the printed Guadagnini-Pilo conjecture
    Manuscript dated 5 October 2026; current files 10 October 2026 · Unrefereed preprint

    Full ordinary SU(5) at WZW level 5 (shifted level 10) gives unequal nonzero S³-normalized magnitudes for L(5,1) and L(5,2), both with fundamental group ℤ/5.

    PDF · Zenodo
